description: Make 8-bit style sound effects from nothing: coin, laser, explosion, power-up, hit, jump, menu blip, click. Several takes or a family of variations per call, repeatable by seed, peak-normalized and trimmed, as WAV, OGG or MP3. Yours to use anywhere. Price: $0.02 USDC via x402, charged only on success. Part of Audio tools: Make generated or recorded sounds game-ready: trim silence and match loudness (LUFS with a true-peak ceiling), seamless loops for music and ambience with loop points, and SFX variations.

count.description: How many sounds. With variations off each is a fresh take on the kind.

kind.description: coin: pickup; laser: shot; explosion; powerup; hit: damage; jump; blip: menu move; click: button; synth and tone: notes; random: anything.

params.description: Re-render one exact sound from the params a previous call returned.

seed.description: Same seed and kind, same sound. Random when omitted; the seed used is returned.

variations.description: Make the sounds small mutations of the first one: a family of the same effect, so repeats do not sound robotic.

name: audio_tools_sfx
